$comment: Layout rules for Mini App screens: where the image goes and in what ratio, the order of title, meta, price, rating and availability, card variants, galleries, filters, forms and booking. Used by scripts/miniapp_layout.py (show / review / rules) and explained in references/mini-apps/layout-rules.md. Rules are this skill's heuristics built on Telegram's design guidelines, the iOS 27 proportions in design-sources.json and common commerce and booking practice; they are checked on mock previews, not on user research.

L01.title: One primary action per screen, in the MainButton
L01.fix: Move the main action (Buy, Book, Subscribe, Start) to the MainButton; cards and rows open a detail screen.

L02.title: Image ratio follows the content type
L02.fix: Use the entity's ratio (book cover 2:3, portrait 4:5, product 1:1, video, course and workout 16:9, listing 4:3, event 3:2) and keep it identical across a list.

L03.title: Covers, logos and packshots are contained; photos are cropped
L03.fix: object-fit: contain on a surface for covers, logos, packshots and documents; cover for photos of people, places, food and video frames.

L04.title: Image position by card variant
L04.fix: Media cards and grid tiles: image on top, full width. Rows: a thumbnail at the start (people round, products square, covers 2:3); food menus may put a square photo at the end. Never an image on both sides.

L05.title: Title first among the text, clamped
L05.fix: Order the text: title, then meta, then price. Titles take 2 lines at most in cards and 1 in rows, with an ellipsis.

L06.title: Price under the title, plain and comparable
L06.fix: Price in headline weight with tabular figures and the user's locale; an old price struck through in hint after it; 'from' for variable prices; the period after it ('/ month'); never in an accent pill or on the image.

L07.title: Rating is a short meta, not a star row
L07.fix: Show a star icon (SVG) with '4.8 (120)' in subhead hint next to or under the title; five-star rows only on the detail screen's reviews section.

L08.title: Unavailable stays visible
L08.fix: Sold out, full or closed items stay in the list, dimmed, with the reason in text ('Sold out', 'Full · join waitlist'); never hidden or shown only by colour.

L09.title: Grid columns by width
L09.fix: 2 columns from 320 to 559 px, 3 from 560 px, gaps 8-12 px; equal tile heights from a fixed media ratio and clamped titles.

L10.title: Horizontal scrollers only for featured or related
L10.fix: At most one horizontal scroller per screen and never as the main catalogue; 10 items at most, the next card peeking.

L11.title: Detail screens follow one section order
L11.fix: Media, title and price, selectors (size, format, date), key facts, description, details list, reviews, related. The primary action in the MainButton.

L12.title: Galleries by purpose
L12.fix: On a detail screen: one carousel with dots and a counter, tap opens a viewer screen with BackButton. For a collection: a 3-column square grid. For videos and workouts: 16:9 tiles with a duration badge. No masonry, no autoplaying sliders.

L13.title: Filters and sort sit under the title
L13.fix: Up to 5 quick filters as a chip row under the title (sticky on scroll), sort as a pill select; more than 5 filters go in a sheet opened by 'Filters (n)'. Always show the result count.

L14.title: Search at the top of list screens
L14.fix: A search field under the large title of a list or catalogue root; placeholder 'Search'; results as you type; an empty result explains and offers to clear filters.

L15.title: Forms are one column with labels above
L15.fix: Labels above fields, one column, related fields grouped in a section, inputmode and autocomplete set, the error under the field, submit in the MainButton (disabled with the reason in the content).

L16.title: Booking: day strip, slot grid, summary, then the MainButton
L16.fix: A horizontal strip of days, a grid of time slots (3-4 columns), unavailable slots disabled not hidden, a one-line summary of the choice, and a MainButton naming the slot and price ('Book Tue 18:00 · €30').

L17.title: Card text stays short
L17.fix: One meta line in cards; descriptions only on the detail screen, 3 lines then 'More'; no paragraphs in lists.

L18.title: One tag per card, no ribbons
L18.fix: At most one quiet tag (top-start on the media or after the title): 'New', 'Ends 30 Nov', '−20 %'. No corner ribbons, no stacks of badges.

L19.title: One secondary control on a card at most
L19.fix: The whole card opens the detail screen; at most one icon button on it (favourite at the media's top end, or quick add at the bottom end), 44 px target.

L20.title: No text on images
L20.fix: Put text under the media. If a title must sit on a photo, use a bottom scrim and check 4.5:1 in both themes.

L21.title: Values align at the end of rows
L21.fix: Prices, amounts and times right-aligned (start in RTL) in tabular figures; times in schedules form the leading column.

L22.title: Media carries meaning in alt text
L22.fix: alt names what the image shows (product and variant, trainer's name, workout title); decorative images alt="".

L23.title: Loading and empty keep the anatomy
L23.fix: Skeletons in the card's own shape (media ratio, two text lines, price); empty results say why and offer a way out.

L24.title: Wide screens cap the content
L24.fix: Content up to ~600 px wide and centred on tablets and desktop clients; images capped in height; grids gain a column instead of stretching tiles.

L25.title: Plans: stacked cards on phones, a table to compare
L25.fix: Plans as stacked cards or one radio list (not side by side) under 600 px; one quietly recommended plan; 3-5 features each with an icon and text; a comparison table when there are more than 3 plans or 6 features. Stars subscriptions renew every 30 days: no 'yearly' Stars subscription; a longer term is a one-off payment that says it does not renew.

L26.title: Paywall: the full anatomy, server-owned, every state (payments.md section 9)
L26.fix: A level-2 screen or sheet opened from a locked thing: intro (mark, title, one line) -> what you get in numbers (3-5 rows) -> Free and Premium side by side -> plans as one radio group with the Stars glyph, the amount and the period or 'no renewal' -> renewal and cancel terms with the Terms link under the plans -> questions (cancel, progress, renewal). The MainButton names the verb, the price and the period of the selected plan. Prices and unlocking come from the server; loading, error, cancelled, failed, pending, success and subscriber states are drawn. Reference: examples/mini-apps/paywall.

row.what: list row with a thumbnail at the start
row.for: people, services, menus, search results, history

trainer.title: Trainer or specialist
trainer.ratio: 4:5 portrait in cards, round avatar 48-56 in rows

menu-item.title: Food or drink menu item
menu-item.ratio: 1:1 photo at the end of the row

article.title: Article or news
article.ratio: 16:9 in cards, 1:1 72 px thumbnail at the end in rows

metric.title: SaaS dashboard metric
metric.primary: none on the dashboard; actions on detail screens

person.title: Person in a community or CRM

photo.title: Photo in a gallery (results, workouts, venue)
photo.ratio: 1:1 in the grid, original in the viewer
photo.fit: cover in the grid, contain in the viewer
